title: std::shared_future<T>::~shared_future
summary: If *this is the last object referring to the shared state, destroys the shared state. Otherwise does nothing.
html:
~shared_future();
 (since C++11)

If *this is the last object referring to the shared state, destroys the shared state. Otherwise does nothing.
